steps.en: Install the skill globally into your agent
steps.zh: 把技能全局装进你的 agent

steps.en: Ask a coding question as usual
Shortens the prose; code, commands, and errors stay exact
steps.zh: 只缩短周围的话，代码、命令和报错原样保留

steps.en: Switch intensity when the default is too much or too little
steps.zh: 默认太狠或太松时调档

steps.en: Say stop when you want normal prose back
steps.zh: 想恢复正常文风时说一句 stop

steps.en: Reverts for the session; the agent talks normally again

value.en: Same diagnosis, fewer filler tokens; code and errors never get rewritten
value.zh: 诊断还在，铺垫没了；代码和报错不会被改写
